components.name: Primary action
components.description: Primary action as implemented in Instrument.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid #b0b5ab;color:#232720;background:#f2f2ec;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffffb3,0 1px 0 #23272024;transition:background-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease;background:#e65e27;color:#11160e;border-color:#a84018;font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff40,0 1px 0 #23272033;}.ds-button-primary:not(:disabled):hover{background:#e5e7df;color:#232720;border-color:#7c8575;background:#ee7647;color:#11160e;border-color:#8f3716;}.ds-button-primary:not(:disabled):active{background:#dc5e2c;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #276783;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{color:#777c72;border-color:#c0c4ba;box-shadow:none;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Inset paper field with a visible label and focus.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:#60675b;font:500 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-field input{font:400 14px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:10px 11px;background:#fafaf5;color:#232720;border:1px solid #939b89;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #2327200d;}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#6d7762;}.ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:#276783;outline:2px solid #276783;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-field input:disabled{color:#777c72;background:#e0e2d9;border-color:#c0c4ba;box-shadow:none;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px;}}

components.name: Inspector navigation
components.description: Composition, Artwork and Body keys with the selected orange edge.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:7px;background:#d6d9ce;border:1px solid #b0b5ab;}.ds-tabs button{flex:1;min-height:44px;padding:9px 5px;font:400 12px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;background:#f2f2ec;color:#60675b;border:1px solid #a5ad99;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #23272024;cursor:pointer;}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#e5e7df;color:#232720;}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#232720;color:#f5f6f0;border-color:#232720;font-weight:500;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #e65e27;}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #276783;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-tabs button:active{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #23272026;}

components.name: Artwork card
components.description: Paper preview and separate add action; demo content stands in for the user image.
components.css: .ds-art{width:160px;background:#e5e8dd;color:#232720;border:1px solid #b0b5ab;border-radius:4px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-preview{display:grid;gap:0;width:100%;padding:5px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#232720;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;}.ds-preview:hover{background:#d9decf;}.ds-paper{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:100px;background:#fafaf5;border:1px solid #b0b5ab;border-radius:2px;color:#60675b;font-size:12px;text-align:center;}.ds-preview strong{margin-top:8px;min-height:38px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:500;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-art-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding:3px;border-top:1px solid #b0b5ab;}.ds-add{min-width:62px;min-height:44px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #9caa8d;border-radius:3px;background:#f2f2ec;color:#232720;font:500 14px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80,0 1px 0 #2327201a;}.ds-add:hover{background:#e65e27;border-color:#a84018;color:#11160e;}.ds-art button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #276783;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-art button:active{background:#cdd0c8;}

components.name: Range control
components.description: Rectangular ink thumb and exact value field; HTML demonstrates the two native input affordances.
components.css: .ds-range{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 80px;align-items:center;gap:0 12px;color:#60675b;font:400 13px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-range .ds-exact{min-height:44px;width:76px;border:1px solid #b0b5ab;border-radius:4px;background:#e6e8df;color:#232720;font:12px/1.4 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;text-align:right;}.ds-range input[type=range]{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;height:44px;appearance:none;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;}.ds-range input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:5px;border:1px solid #a2aa98;border-radius:2px;background:#cdd0c8;}.ds-range input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;width:18px;height:24px;margin-top:-10px;border:1px solid #303a28;border-radius:3px;background:#232720;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff38,0 1px 1px #23272030;}.ds-range input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:3px;border:1px solid #a2aa98;border-radius:2px;background:#cdd0c8;}.ds-range input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:22px;border:1px solid #303a28;border-radius:3px;background:#232720;}.ds-range input:hover{border-color:#6d7762;}.ds-range input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #276783;outline-offset:3px;}

narrative.overview:
The established interface is a framed display beside a solid control deck. Putty surfaces, dark text and small state accents support precise adjustment while the body and artwork occupy the viewing area. This records the chosen implementation; it does not introduce a new visual concept.

The public pages share the type and palette but use larger type and a reading grid. Route-specific intent belongs in the surface briefs. Glass remains a compatibility presentation at `?theme=glass`; its translucent surfaces do not define Instrument.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque putty panels with thin, visible boundaries.
IBM Plex Sans with monospaced measurements.
Recessed preview, compact control geometry and restrained state color.

rules.name: State Color
rules.body: Retain distinct selected, focus, saved and error treatments; color must accompany labels, icons, borders or control semantics.

rules.name: Task Scale
rules.body: Keep large public-page typography out of editing controls. Long study and artwork names must wrap without displacing actions.

dos: Do preserve the Instrument font, palette and modest framed geometry.
Do retain visible selection, focus, save recovery and accessible labels at every size.
Do verify narrow, short portrait, short landscape, long-content, expanded-sheet and error states.
Do use original demo artwork for public captures and preserve actual body lighting and material setup.
donts: Don't replace the chosen world with glass, decorative gradients or a new typography system during refinement.
Don't hide essential controls behind hover or clip long labels and recovery messages.
Don't let presentation changes reset studies, undo history, panel state or the Three.js canvas.
Don't remove reduced-motion, forced-color or opaque accessibility treatments.
